paragraphs: European leaders met in Dublin on Thursday. It was a big meeting called the European Political Community. Taoiseach Micheál Martin was the host.
The war in Ukraine was the main topic. Many leaders said Europe must be part of any peace talks.
Two American officials flew to Dublin from Moscow. They had met the Russian president there. Then they spoke with Ukraine's president, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, near Dublin.
Zelenskiy said there was some progress. The Americans now agree that Europe should join future talks. But there was no big change in the war.
European leaders do not yet agree on who will speak for Europe. About 1,000 people protested against war in the city. Police kept them away from the leaders.
sentZh: 歐洲各國領袖週四在都柏林會面。
這是一場名為「歐洲政治共同體」的大型會議。
總理米歇爾·馬丁擔任東道主。
烏克蘭戰爭是主要議題。
許多領袖表示，歐洲必須參與任何和平談判。
兩名美國官員從莫斯科飛到都柏林。
他們先前在那裡與俄羅斯總統會面。
隨後他們在都柏林附近與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基會談。
澤倫斯基說有一些進展。
美方現在同意歐洲應參加未來的談判。
但戰事沒有重大變化。
歐洲領袖們尚未就由誰代表歐洲發言達成共識。
約一千人在市區舉行反戰抗議。
警方讓他們遠離各國領袖。

paragraphs: Leaders from across Europe gathered in Dublin on Thursday for a meeting of the European Political Community. It was the ninth meeting of the group, and Taoiseach Micheál Martin hosted it at the Convention Centre Dublin. Leaders from the UK, Canada and Norway, which are not in the EU, were also there.
The war in Ukraine was the main subject of the day. Again and again, leaders said that Europe must have a place in any talks to end the war.

Late on Thursday, two US negotiators, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, flew to Casement Aerodrome in Baldonnel. They had just met Russian president Vladimir Putin in Moscow. The Irish Government helped to arrange their meeting with Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskiy.
Kushner said the US side had pushed for Europeans to be included in the talks. Zelenskiy said there was progress on this point. However, there was little sign of a breakthrough to end the fighting.

European Council president António Costa said Europe's security could not be discussed without Europe. But Italian prime minister Giorgia Meloni said the EU seemed confused about Ukraine. Leaders also did not agree on who should represent Europe.

Outside, about 1,000 people joined an anti-war protest. Gardaí kept them away from the venue, and two men were arrested after minor scuffles. In the evening, the Government held a dinner for the leaders at the National Gallery.
sentZh: 歐洲各地的領袖週四齊聚都柏林，出席歐洲政治共同體會議。
這是該組織第九次會議，由總理馬丁在都柏林會議中心主持。
英國、加拿大和挪威這些非歐盟國家的領袖也出席了。
烏克蘭戰爭是當天的主要話題。
領袖們一再表示，歐洲必須在任何結束戰爭的談判中占有一席之地。
週四深夜，兩名美國談判代表威特科夫與庫什納飛抵巴爾多內爾的凱斯門特機場。
他們剛在莫斯科會見俄羅斯總統普丁。
愛爾蘭政府協助安排他們與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基的會面。
庫什納說，美方曾力主讓歐洲人參與談判。
澤倫斯基說這一點已有進展。
不過，幾乎看不到結束戰鬥的突破跡象。
歐洲理事會主席科斯塔表示，討論歐洲安全不能沒有歐洲。
但義大利總理梅洛尼說，歐盟在烏克蘭問題上似乎很混亂。
領袖們也未就應由誰代表歐洲達成一致。
場外約有一千人參加反戰抗議。
警方讓他們遠離會場，兩名男子在輕微推擠後被捕。
晚上，政府在國家美術館為各國領袖設宴。

paragraphs: The war in Ukraine dominated a gathering of European leaders in Dublin on Thursday, as Taoiseach Micheál Martin hosted the ninth meeting of the European Political Community. The summit at the Convention Centre Dublin brought together the heads of EU and non-EU countries, including the UK, Canada and Norway, as well as the leaders of NATO and the EU.
Throughout the day, leaders insisted that Europe must have a seat at the table in any negotiations to end the conflict.

Late on Thursday, US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner flew directly from talks with Russian president Vladimir Putin in Moscow to Casement Aerodrome in Baldonnel. There, in a meeting facilitated by the Irish Government, they briefed Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskiy.

Kushner said the American side had argued for Europeans to be involved, and Zelenskiy said progress had been made on their participation in future talks. Even so, there was little sign of a breakthrough, and European sources said Russia had not softened its demands.

Polish prime minister Donald Tusk said that calling the current discussions negotiations was an exaggeration. European Council president António Costa told reporters that European security could not be discussed without Europe, and he believed the Americans accepted this.

However, Italian prime minister Giorgia Meloni described the EU as all over the place on Ukraine, and leaders were no closer to deciding who would speak for Europe. Meanwhile, around 1,000 anti-war protesters were kept away from the venue by gardaí, and two men were arrested after minor scuffles.
sentZh: 週四，烏克蘭戰爭主導了在都柏林舉行的歐洲領袖聚會，總理馬丁主持了第九屆歐洲政治共同體會議。
在都柏林會議中心舉行的這場峰會，匯集了歐盟及非歐盟國家（包括英國、加拿大和挪威）的領導人，以及北約和歐盟的負責人。
整天下來，領袖們堅持歐洲必須在任何結束衝突的談判中有一席之地。
週四深夜，美國特使威特科夫與庫什納在莫斯科與俄羅斯總統普丁會談後，直接飛抵巴爾多內爾的凱斯門特機場。
在愛爾蘭政府促成的會面中，他們向烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基簡報情況。
庫什納說美方曾主張讓歐洲人參與，澤倫斯基則表示，歐洲參與未來談判一事已取得進展。
儘管如此，幾乎看不到突破的跡象，歐洲消息人士說俄羅斯並未軟化其要求。
波蘭總理圖斯克說，把目前的討論稱為談判是誇大其詞。
歐洲理事會主席科斯塔告訴記者，討論歐洲安全不能沒有歐洲，而他相信美方接受這一點。
然而，義大利總理梅洛尼形容歐盟在烏克蘭問題上方向混亂，領袖們在決定由誰代表歐洲發言方面也毫無進展。
與此同時，約一千名反戰抗議者被警方擋在會場之外，兩名男子在輕微推擠後被捕。

paragraphs: Ukraine overshadowed every other item on the agenda as European leaders converged on Dublin on Thursday for the ninth summit of the European Political Community, hosted by Taoiseach Micheál Martin. The gathering at the Convention Centre Dublin drew not only EU heads of government but also counterparts from the UK, Canada and Norway, alongside the chiefs of NATO and the EU institutions.
A recurring refrain throughout the day was that Europe cannot be sidelined in any settlement to end the war.

Late that evening, the US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner flew straight from an audience with Vladimir Putin in Moscow to Casement Aerodrome, Baldonnel, where, with the Irish Government acting as facilitator, they briefed Volodymyr Zelenskiy. Kushner maintained that Washington had lobbied for European involvement, and the Ukrainian president claimed headway had been made on that front.

Nevertheless, a breakthrough appeared elusive, with senior European sources reporting no indication that Moscow had tempered its sweeping war aims. Poland's Donald Tusk was blunter still, dismissing the label negotiations as an overstatement.

At the closing press conference, European Council president António Costa asserted that the future of the continent's security could not be debated in Europe's absence, adding that he believed Washington now conceded the point. Yet the facade of unity was punctured when Italy's Giorgia Meloni remarked that the bloc seemed all over the place, and leaders remained undecided on who might represent Europe.
Beyond the security cordon, some 1,000 anti-war demonstrators were held at a distance by gardaí, and two men were detained following minor scuffles.
sentZh: 週四，歐洲領袖齊聚都柏林出席由總理馬丁主辦的第九屆歐洲政治共同體峰會，烏克蘭議題蓋過了議程上的其他一切。
在都柏林會議中心的這場聚會，不僅吸引了歐盟各國政府首腦，也有來自英國、加拿大和挪威的對等領袖，以及北約和歐盟機構的首長。
一整天反覆出現的論調是：在任何結束戰爭的和解中，歐洲都不能被邊緣化。
當晚稍後，美國特使威特科夫與庫什納在莫斯科晉見普丁後直飛巴爾多內爾的凱斯門特機場，並在愛爾蘭政府居中協調下向澤倫斯基簡報。
庫什納堅稱華府曾遊說讓歐洲參與，烏克蘭總統則稱在這方面已取得進展。
然而，突破似乎遙不可及，歐洲高層消息人士表示，沒有跡象顯示莫斯科已緩和其全面的戰爭目標。
波蘭的圖斯克說得更直白，駁斥「談判」這個稱呼言過其實。
在閉幕記者會上，歐洲理事會主席科斯塔斷言，在歐洲缺席的情況下無法討論歐陸安全的未來，並補充說他相信華府如今已承認這一點。
然而，義大利的梅洛尼表示歐盟似乎方向紛亂，團結的表象因此被戳破，領袖們也仍未決定由誰代表歐洲。
在安全封鎖線外，約一千名反戰示威者被警方擋在遠處，兩名男子在輕微推擠後遭拘留。

paragraphs: The conflict in Ukraine dominated proceedings in Dublin on Thursday, when Taoiseach Micheál Martin hosted the ninth summit of the European Political Community. The event, held at the Convention Centre Dublin, assembled a substantial number of European heads of government, including leaders from non-EU states such as the UK, Canada and Norway, as well as the heads of NATO and the EU.
A consistent theme emerged: participants argued that any durable peace settlement would be contingent upon meaningful European involvement.

Later that evening, the US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner travelled directly from discussions with Vladimir Putin in Moscow to Casement Aerodrome, Baldonnel, where they briefed Volodymyr Zelenskiy in a meeting facilitated by the Irish Government. Kushner stated that the American delegation had advocated European participation, and Zelenskiy subsequently reported progress in this regard.

Nevertheless, there was scant evidence of a substantive breakthrough, as European officials observed no indication that Russia had moderated its objectives. Consequently, Polish prime minister Donald Tusk characterised the description of the current contacts as negotiations as an exaggeration.

European Council president António Costa maintained that the future of European security could not legitimately be determined without Europe, and he expressed confidence that Washington accepted this principle. However, divisions were apparent, with Italy's Giorgia Meloni suggesting that the EU's position appeared incoherent, while leaders failed to reach a consensus on who should represent the continent.
In parallel, approximately 1,000 anti-war protesters were kept at a distance from the venue by gardaí, and two men were arrested following minor scuffles.

這場在都柏林會議中心舉行的活動，匯聚了相當多的歐洲政府首腦，包括英國、加拿大、挪威等非歐盟國家的領袖，以及北約和歐盟的首長。
一個一貫的主題浮現：與會者主張，任何持久的和平協議都取決於歐洲的實質參與。
當晚稍後，美國特使威特科夫和庫什納在莫斯科與普丁會談後直接前往巴爾多內爾的凱斯門特機場，在愛爾蘭政府促成的會議中向澤倫斯基簡報。

然而，幾乎沒有實質突破的證據，因為歐洲官員沒有觀察到俄羅斯緩和其目標的跡象。
因此，波蘭總理圖斯克形容，將目前的接觸稱為談判是一種誇大。
歐洲理事會主席科斯塔堅稱，沒有歐洲就不能正當地決定歐洲安全的未來，並對華府接受此原則表示有信心。
然而，分歧顯而易見：義大利的梅洛尼暗示歐盟立場似乎前後不一，而領袖們也未能就應由誰代表歐陸達成共識。
與此同時，約一千名反戰抗議者被警方隔離在會場之外，兩名男子在輕微推擠後被捕。
